name: github.com/faiface/beep/mp3
reason: Wraps github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3 (hajime/go-mp3 lineage); not counted as a separate plain MP3 parser in this pilot.

name: github.com/dhowden/tag
reason: Tag metadata reader (ID3, MP4, FLAC, OGG); does not decode MPEG audio frames, so it cannot give a frame-derived or decoded-audio result for an untagged MP3.

name: github.com/hajimehoshi/ebiten/v2/audio/mp3
reason: Ebitengine audio wrapper around github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3; not counted separately.

name: github.com/tcolgate/mp3
reason: Frame decoder with documented NewDecoder(io.Reader).Decode(*Frame,*int); verified in mp3_id3v2 on a tagged control, but an untagged-control adapter, source coverage and AFL++ bridge for this pilot remain unchecked.

name: github.com/gopxl/beep/v2/mp3
reason: Fork of faiface/beep; wraps github.com/hajimehoshi/go-mp3; not counted separately.

name: github.com/bluenviron/mediacommon/v2/pkg/codecs/mpeg4audio
reason: MPEG-4 audio (AAC) configuration utilities, not MPEG-1/2 Layer III files.

name: github.com/tosone/minimp3
reason: cgo binding with vendored minimp3.h (separate C decoder family); documented DecodeFull([]byte) is verified in mp3_id3v2 on a tagged control, but this pilot has not checked it on the untagged controls or bridged C source coverage.

name: github.com/sjzar/go-lame
reason: LAME encoder binding; the documented API encodes PCM rather than parsing MP3 input.

name: github.com/200sc/klangsynthese/mp3
reason: Documented Load(io.ReadCloser); its adapter panicked on the tagged mp3_id3v2 control and was not retried on the untagged controls.

name: github.com/dmulholl/mp3lib
reason: Documented NextFrame reads MPEG frames from a stream; control adapter remains unchecked.

name: github.com/korandiz/mpa
reason: GPL-3.0 MPEG-1 Audio decoder (separate implementation); control adapter remains unchecked.

name: github.com/gen2brain/mpeg
reason: Documented audio decoder handles MPEG-1 Layer II inside MPEG-PS, not Layer III MP3 streams.

name: github.com/derat/mpeg
reason: Documented ReadFrameInfo reads MPEG audio frame headers from a file; control adapter remains unchecked.

name: github.com/fgergo/mp3
reason: Fork of github.com/tcolgate/mp3 frame decoder (same lineage); unchecked.
